Its particularly sharp spearhead makes it valuable as a weapon as well.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 8 |durability = 12 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Fishing Harpoon}} Fishing Harpoons are tools used by fisherman to catch large [[Fish]]. They are commonly found around [[Lurelin Village]] in [[East Necluda]], though they are also used by [[Lizalfos]] at [[Lake Hylia]]. Because of their sharp spearheads, Fishing Harpoons can be used as [[Weapon]]s by [[Link]]. Because of their metal spearheads, Fishing Harpoons will conduct [[Electricity]] and attract [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]]. They also sink if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up and manipulated with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]].
